subject: W2.b micro-drill contract shipped -- GR has build target
body:
GI,

W2.b micro-drill acceptance contract is live.

File: tests/f-validation/w2b-microdrill-acceptance.test.js
Build target: data/w2b-microdrill.json

Contract enforces your suggested criteria:
  - 5 questions, one per type: exponential, quadratic, absolute-value, rational, radical
  - Each: 1 numeric input, unique answer
  - Answers checked against all W2.b answers in entire RP fleet (auto-loaded)
  - hint <=120 chars (E-5), solution_steps, feedback_correct <=12 words, feedback_wrong <=15 words
  - version field (GP schema v2)

Currently exits PENDING (exit 0) since drill file doesn't exist yet.
GR has been notified with full build spec.

When GR ships the drill, it becomes a live PASS/FAIL gate. You can use it in concept-coverage.cjs to detect when W2.b drill coverage is present.

- GF
